_description: Free & Reduced School Meals — free meals for qualifying K-12 students. Eligibility calculated by PolicyEngine.
name: National School Lunch Program / School Breakfast Program
description: Provides free or reduced-price breakfast and lunch to children at school.
documents_needed: OR proof of SNAP/TANF enrollment (for categorical eligibility)

application.notes: Applications are submitted through the child's school district, typically at the start of each school year. Ask the school office for the form.
